methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 verifiable sunrise-simulation wake-up lights: Philips' light-therapy line (HF3500, HF3520, HF3650), smart connected devices (Hatch Restore 2, Loftie Lamp, Casper Glow, and the discontinued pioneer Withings Aura, kept as a historically notable model), UK-market Lumie Bodyclock units, and budget Amazon staples (hOmeLabs, JALL). Sources: official manufacturer pages (Philips, Hatch/Forbes, Casper, Lumie, Loftie) and a Philips spec-sheet PDF, cross-checked against retailer listings and hands-on reviews (Forbes Vetted, Reviewed.com, Mattress Clarity, LiveWorkSleep, TechCrunch). 'Mytime Sunrise' remains excluded as non-existent. max_brightness_lux is in lux; sound_options_count counts distinct built-in sleep/wake sounds excluding FM radio; booleans mark plain feature presence; color_options is free text. Fields not published by manufacturers are recorded null rather than estimated. accessedAt 2026-08-16. Adversarial re-verification (2026-08-16): all 11 products confirmed real (0 removed) and headline specs corroborated against official/primary pages. Corrections applied: Hatch Restore 2 tap_snooze true->false (physical buttons, not a tap sensor, per Forbes Vetted); priceUsd set null for hOmeLabs, JALL and Philips HF3500 where no fixed/confirmable published USD price exists. Confirmed-correct prices kept: Casper Glow $129, Lumie Shine 300 $169, Loftie Lamp $279.99, Withings Aura $299.95 (2014 launch).
